description: This file contains test cases written with the Vitest framework for testing configuration extensions related to include patterns in an OpenClaw project. It imports necessary testing functions, helper modules, and performs tests on the loadIncludePatternsFromEnv function with different scenarios, such as no configuration, valid JSON file, and invalid JSON structure.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Registers a cleanup function to be executed after each test case.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for grouping related test cases.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates an expectation/assertion for testing expected outcomes.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases with specific behavior or expectations.
